حول البرنامج ومنهجيته: About the app and its method
Mo Stocks برنامج على جهازك لتحليل الأسهم: Mo Stocks is an app on your computer for analysing Saudi, Egyptian and US stocks, gold and funds. Every figure is worked out from published data, with its source, and whatever has no data is marked unavailable, never guessed.
تُرصد القمم والقيعان المحلية، وتُجمع الم: Local highs and lows are found and the close ones are grouped into one zone whose width comes from the average daily range (ATR). A zone grows stronger with the number and recency of touches, the volume traded in it, showing on the weekly chart, and switching between support and resistance. The buy zone is the nearest strong zone below the price; the sell zone the nearest above.
إغلاق واضح خلف المنطقة بحجم تداول يزيد 4: A clear close beyond the zone on volume at least 40% above its 20-day average, with the price holding afterwards. A breakout after which the price returns inside the zone counts as false.
الحكم (شراء أو بيع أو انتظار) يجمع موقع: The verdict (buy, sell or wait) combines where the price sits against the zones with trend, momentum, volume and reward to risk. Confidence combines the strength of these reasons with how often the same setup worked on this stock in the back-test. Confidence is not a guaranteed chance of profit.
خطة السعر والعائد إلى المخاطرة: Price plan and reward to risk
الدخول عند منطقة الشراء، والوقف تحتها بج: Entry at the buy zone, the stop below it by part of the daily range, and the three targets are the next resistance zones in order. Reward to risk = (first target − entry) ÷ (entry − stop).
درجة من 100 لإعداد الشراء، مقسمة على أجز: A score out of 100 for the buy setup, split into the parts shown on the stock page: nearness to support, trend, momentum, volume and reward to risk.
وسيط عدة طرق، كل منها مذكور مع أرقامه: م: The median of several methods, each shown with its figures: the analysts' average target (counted twice, as it carries forecasts and news), earnings per share × sector P/E, book value × sector multiple for banks, dividend yield against the sector, Graham's formula, next year's earnings, the stock's own past P/E, and a simplified discounted cash flow. A method giving a figure far from the price is left out. The confidence level reflects how far the methods agree. The scanner uses the same method without the stock's past P/E.
